# f5xc_enhanced_firewall_policy (Resource)

EnhancedFirewallPolicy resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "f5xc_enhanced_firewall_policy" "example" {
  name      = "example_enhanced_firewall_policy"
  namespace = "example_namespace"
  rule_choice = {
    denied_destinations = {
      denied_destinations = "example_denied_destinations"
    }
  }
}
```
